name: theme_roshnilite
description: Dev tooling for theme_roshnilite: local Moodle Docker environment, coding-standards checker, and AMD build.

scripts.env:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.lint:php: for f in $(find . -name '*.php' -not -path './vendor/*'); do php -l "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.lint: npm run lint:php && npm run lint:phpcs
